bio: The chef grew up eating vegetables from the family garden in Yamagata and the restaurant is the fulfilment of a dream that one day he would serve cuisine made with vegetables grown by his parents. Deep-fried tofu leavened with those veggies brings the seasons of his hometown to the table. His affection for his ingredients inspired him to prepare kombu soy sauce for his sashimi, reusing the kombu from the soup stock. Akanezaka, the older name for Akasaka meaning ‘Red Hill’, conjures crimson associations of sunrise and sunset....
